dropdownMenu.$description: DropdownMenu (renamed from Menu 2026-10-26 — Radix/Storybook's name) — a dropdown action menu — a list of things you *do* (Rename, Duplicate, Delete), not a list of selectable options with persistent state (that's Listbox, a separate component — the ARIA role and keyboard model genuinely differ: menu/menuitem vs. listbox/option). Built on Popover's same shell: native `popover` attribute (top-layer, outside-click/Escape dismissal for free), border.default + shadow.sm + radius.default, the same small positioning script. This project doesn't implement real arrow-key/type-ahead keyboard navigation or ARIA roles (a static tokens+docs generator, not a live component library) — noted here so nobody mistakes the visual-only demo for a complete accessible implementation; a real port needs roving tabindex and role=menu/menuitem added on top of these tokens. Item types (2026-10-26): plain action (closes the menu), checkbox item (role=menuitemcheckbox — toggles a view setting such as a visible column, ✓ in a leading slot, the menu stays open, several can be on), radio item (role=menuitemradio — one of a group such as sort order, a dot in the leading slot, stays open), submenu trigger (trailing ›, opens a nested menu beside it on hover, click or →, flips to the left when there is no room). A group label ('Sort order') heads a group — Command's group-heading recipe, resolved from command.tokens.json, not re-declared. A checkbox/radio item changes something right away; a value a form submits is Listbox (Select) instead.

itemRadius.$description: 4px — concentric with the panel's own 8px radius minus the 4px outer padding (the same inner=outer-padding rule learned building Tabs' pill-in-track), so an item sitting in the top corner curves smoothly with the panel instead of fighting it.

padding.$description: 4px outer padding around the whole item list.

gap.$description: 2px between items — same as Popover's own menu example.

itemHeight.$description: 36px, declared — 8px padding + a 14px × 1.4 line rendered 35.6px (off the 4px grid). Same 36 as Command and TimePicker rows. Replaced itemPaddingY 2026-10-26.

itemGap.$description: 8px between an item's icon and its label — same flat gap Button uses.

size.$description: 16px leading slot for ✓ / dot. Every item in a group that has indicators reserves it, so labels line up whether or not their item is on.

dot.$description: 8px radio dot, centered in the slot — a dot, not a full Radio ring: inside a menu the ring is heavy, and a dot vs. a ✓ is enough to tell one-of from many.

indicator.$description: Indicator colour is Listbox's selected checkmark (fill.primary), resolved from listbox.tokens.json — the same 'this one is on' blue.

overlap.$description: 4px — the submenu sits over the parent panel's edge by its padding, so the pointer never crosses a gap moving into it, and its first item lines up with the trigger.

submenu.$description: Trigger = an ordinary item + trailing chevron_right (icon.secondary, iconSize); it keeps the hover fill while its submenu is open, so you can see which item it came from.

hoverBg.$description: Pale red tint (the same passive-surface role Card/badges would use), not fill.neutralHover — a destructive item's hover should read as 'still red', not revert to neutral gray.
